_note: Salted hashes of phrases the contest build must not contain: hashes only, never the phrases. Regenerate with a fresh salt if the list changes.
scheme: hex(sha256(utf8(salt + text))). text = NFKC, lowercase, letters-only tokens ([a-z]+). Every 1-token window, every 2-token window joined by ONE space and every 2-token window joined with NO space is hashed and compared; a match on any entry fails the frozen build (vr/src/freeze-guard.js).
